title: Yusuf Terzi | Portfolio
intro: I'm an English Language Teaching student who loves building things in the classroom and on the web.
timelineTitle: What I have done since starting university.
timelineNote: Of course, there is more, but I do not want to write that I brush my teeth; everyone does this.
birthText: This long line started in Bursa.
mysteryTooltip: This part is buried in the dark corners of history. To learn it, you have to know me personally.
universityTitle: I started English Language Teaching at Bursa Uludağ University.
universityText: I began my undergraduate studies in English Language Teaching at Bursa Uludağ University.
societyTitle: I founded the BUU English Language Teaching Society.
societyText: I founded Bursa Uludağ University English Language Teaching Society under the supervision of my advisor Prof. Dr. Zübeyde Sinem Genç.
hackathonTitle: I took first place at the Nilüfer AI Hackathon.
hackathonText: I won the Nilüfer AI Hackathon with my teammate Metin Torun.
gaziText: Under the guidance of my advisor Prof. Dr. Zübeyde Sinem Genç, I received the green light from Osmangazi Municipality for the Gazi Project, shaped around preparing an Osmangazi-themed coursebook, developing materials, and providing training for teaching English to adults, and I am still working on its first part.
unidesTitle: My ÜNİDES "Future Educators Code" project was approved.
unidesText: My "Future Educators Code" project, prepared under ÜNİDES by the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Youth and Sports, was approved. I wrote the project through Bursa Uludağ University English Language Teaching Society, where I serve as president, and carried it out with my friend Metin Torun on May 2-3, 2026.
tubitakText: My project "AI-Supported Board Game Creation Platform in Foreign Language Education," which I submitted with my project partner Metin Torun to the 2025 call of the TÜBİTAK 2209-A University Students Research Projects Support Program, was accepted.
buueltsProductText: A PHP-based dynamic website I built for the Bursa Uludağ University English Language Teaching Society.
terziGameText: A small 2D pixel game experiment built with Phaser JS.
blockyTriviaText: A static, Minecraft-themed fan-made trivia game.
contactText: For questions, ideas, or collaboration, feel free to get in touch.
